newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool - Price ideas soften, sellers wary.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool - Price ideas soften, sellers wary.

text.p: Potential sellers cited occasional mention of prospects to take on UK home market business but added that prices offered were poor and often refused.
With Australia closing for the Easter recess, with prices scarcely managing to hold steady, the background for new business was not very encouraging.

Last week's quoted increases, mainly on strength in the Australian dollar, have been maintained but only just. Traders quoting higher prices earlier this week do not seem to be holding them quite so firmly now.
The combing sector is keeping very busy in Europe and throughout the world, despite talk of over capacity and inability to show profit.
Emphasis is still on the finer merino sector where demand and rising prices have helped to put more pressure on supplies and the machinery involved.

Wool International sold more than 17,000 bales of stockpile wool last week, a good total, and helpful to the market. Stockpile sales over the Easter recess should provide some guidance on new business.
